title:
This epic triggers a set of provided actions if the selected cell meets a certain condition.

**Usage**
Should be triggered on {@link UiSdlDataGrid} `CELL_ACTION_CLICK` events only.
Payload strategy should be merge and the payload must contain a field `actionsToTrigger` containing an array
of {@link UiSdlAction}s to trigger.

**Conditions**
These actions will be triggered if the selected cell is a
{@link Sensor} with the field `numOpenSensorAlerts` greater than 0.

The resulting actions will have their payload merged with the epic's input action.
name: TriggerActionsIfSensorHasAlertsEpic
